notes.title: Liquid Sapling LTD shutting down.
notes.notes:
Dear valued customers, we regret to inform you that as of December 2019 the gaming company Liquid Sapling will be shutting down. This means that the game Karate Krab will no longer be purchasable from the steam store. People that already own KK will of course still be able to play the game. We also will be moving KK to Itchio to preserve the game, if anyone wants to try it in the future. Thank you for all your support. 

Thanks, 
Liquid Sapling Team.

notes.title: Free Update and Discount Later Today!
notes.notes:
Today marks our first update for Karate Krab. Red Sea is a new world away from the main story, where everything is more dangerous and a lot more red! 

These are 6 levels based off original ones from the main story but with a twist. 

Please enjoy this free update, we look forward to hearing your feedback.

Look out today for our first Steam Sale!
